list.title: Surveys

list.emptyActive: There are no open surveys right now

intro.title: Survey

intro.identBody: The care center sees your name together with your answers.

review.sub: Tap Edit to change an answer before you submit. After submitting, answers can't be changed.
review.missing: Some required questions still need an answer
review.anonReminder: Anonymous: your name is not sent with your answers.
review.identReminder: Identified: your name is sent with your answers.
review.offline: Connect to the internet to submit.

thanks.title: Thank you, {{name}}
thanks.bodyAnon: Your answers were sent anonymously to the {{center}} management.
thanks.bodyIdent: Your answers were sent to the {{center}} management.
